# Unlimited Growth Drive

> Google Ads and digital marketing agency for local service businesses in the USA and Canada. Founded in 2021, based in Rajshahi, Bangladesh, working on US and Canadian business hours.

## Key facts
- Services: Google Ads management (Search, Performance Max, Local Services Ads, YouTube), Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads, website and landing page design, conversion tracking (GA4, GTM, call tracking, server-side), local SEO, social media management, CRM and marketing automation.
- Industries: law firms, dentists, medical clinics, med spas, home services (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, remodeling and more), automotive (auto body, collision, detailing, auto repair), real estate, veterinarians.
- Markets served: United States and Canada.
- Guarantee (as stated on the website): 100 qualified leads in 90 days or we keep working for free.
- Clients own their ad accounts, website and data; ad spend is paid directly to the platforms.
- People: Abdus Samad (Founder & CEO, Google Ads mentor and coach), Abdul Alim (Co-owner, account and project management), Nill Mostakim (Co-owner, Google Ads, web design and tracking).
- Contact: support@unlimitedgrowthdrive.com · https://www.unlimitedgrowthdrive.com/contact
